'''Nico Kreidl''' (also published as '''Nico Johannes Kreidl''' and '''Nico Kreidel''') played a constructed list at [[2012 World Championship]] (Day 2). Nico Kreidl also played the [[2019 World Championship]].<ref name="pc-rem">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2019-worlds/ 2019 World Championship], starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013160304/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2019-worlds.html Internet Archive]</ref> Nico Kreidl also played at [[December 2001 Mainz tournament]] on 9 December 2001 with [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Watch Your Step]], according to Vjeko Keskic's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3231">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-01-04-09-12-2001-mainz-germanyd3231/ 09-12-2001-mainz-germany], DeckTech (Vjeko "mighty_maul" Keskic, 4 January 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-01-04-09-12-2001-mainz-germanyd3231/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Card credits ==
The printed credit lines of 3 [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards|Virtual card]]s name "Nico Kreidl" and "Nico Kriedl" (3 original concept credits).<ref name="labels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images. Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The credited cards are in [[Virtual Block 7]] and [[Virtual Set 24]], sets dated 2010–2024 on this wiki. The credits on [[BT-1 & •Triple Zero|•BT-1 & •Triple Zero]] and [[Darth Plagueis|•Darth Plagueis]] are shared with [[Card Credits#Chris Menzel|Chris Menzel]]. The concept credit also names the event or award the concept came from: European MPC Champion 2007 (1 card). The full list of everyone credited is at [[Card Credits]] under [[Card Credits#Nico Kreidl|Nico Kreidl]] and [[Card Credits#Nico Kriedl|Nico Kriedl]] (Card Credits keeps the two spellings apart; on this wiki "Nico Kriedl" already redirects here).
